verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC&VC practice explicitly covers company lifecycle 'from incorporation through to exit' and has offices across relevant jurisdictions (UK, Germany, US, India) plus UK/DE-specific cap table tools, implying some jurisdictional formation know-how, but there is no direct evidence of published guidance comparing entity types (Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs German GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd) for founders choosing where to incorporate. Missing for 10: explicit published comparative guidance content on entity-type/jurisdiction selection, founder-facing articles or decision frameworks naming these specific structures.
